name: create_task
description: Create a new todo task for the authenticated user. The task will be associated with the user's account and can be listed, updated, completed, or deleted later.

title.description: The task title (required). Maximum 500 characters. Should be a clear, concise description of what needs to be done.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the task. Maximum 2000 characters. Can include additional context, notes, or instructions.

success.description: Whether the task was created successfully

task_id.description: UUID of the created task (only present if success=true)

input.title: Call mom tomorrow at 3pm
input.description: Discuss weekend plans and birthday gift ideas

output.message: Task 'Call mom tomorrow at 3pm' created successfully

response.message: Task title must be under 500 characters
